name: Yamakaze Daichi
source:
Hobby: Playing games at an arcade
Likes: Sweet things, Momoka
Dislikes: Boredom
He cooperates with his older sister Momoka to find out the truth about their father's death, but he wants his kind older sister to return.
He is a natural. he is cute and hateful at the same time. In the mornings, he is quite indistinct.
He is in charge of planning operations within the organization.

Shuffle ~Bokura wa Omoi o Tokihanatsu~ Proflie

He is a natural type who has a cute appearance but also has some hateful things to say.
He is the mood maker of Gaisard. From Shakuhi of Ganglion,
Shakuhi, a ganglion, tells him the truth about his father's death.
Usually shows no signs of having lost a relative.
